title: Reasoning-Aware Multicalibrated Reliability Predictors for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.26645v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As people increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) for information, model providers need to communicate meaningful estimates of whether individual responses are correct or, more generally, reliable. In the context of hallucinations, existing work uses multicalibration to make such reliability predictions meaningful across application-relevant groups, such as prompt topics. Topic groups alone, however, can conceal systematic errors: within the same topic and confidence level, responses with different chain-of-thought (CoT) properties may exhibit opposing errors that cancel on average. In this work, we introduce reasoning-aware multicalibration, a framework that supplements application-relevant topic groups with groups derived from observable properties of CoT traces. translated_title: 面向语言模型的推理感知多校准可靠性预测器
translated_abstract: 随着人们越来越依赖大语言模型（LLM）获取信息，模型提供方需要就单个回答是否正确，或更广泛地说是否可靠，给出有意义的估计。在幻觉问题的背景下，现有工作使用多校准技术，使这类可靠性预测在应用相关的分组（例如提示主题）上都保持有意义。然而，仅靠主题分组可能掩盖系统性的错误：在同一主题和置信水平下，具有不同思维链（CoT）特性的回答可能表现出方向相反的错误，其影响在平均后被相互抵消。在本工作中，我们提出了“推理感知多校准”框架，它在应用相关的主题分组基础上，补充了由思维链痕迹的可观测属性所推导出的分组。我们从理论上指出，基于思维链的分组是“内部重要的”，即对于此类分组，多校准保证并非社会（性）……
tldr: 该论文提出“推理感知多校准”框架，通过在应用相关主题分组之外补充基于思维链痕迹可观测属性的分组，来揭示并消除主题分组所掩盖的可靠性预测中的系统性错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces reasoning-aware multicalibration, a framework that supplements application-relevant topic groups with groups derived from observable chain-of-thought properties, thereby uncovering and correcting systematic errors in reliability predictions that topic-based groupings alone conceal.
